fluff.overview: The hipposaur is a massive amphibious creature native to the Periphery world of Vixen, classified as Hipposaurus Amphibius Vixenis. Substantially larger than a Terran horse, the hipposaur combines overland mobility with the ability to traverse rivers, swamps, and coastal shallows, making it one of the few beast mounts capable of true amphibious operations. Local Magistracy forces and Periphery militias recognized the creature's military potential early, employing hipposaur-mounted infantry to patrol Vixen's extensive wetlands and waterways where vehicles bog down or cannot operate at all. The animals are sturdy enough to carry riders equipped with crew-served support weapons in addition to personal arms. Hipposaur-mounted platoons are rare outside the Periphery, as the creatures do not adapt well to environments lacking the warm, humid conditions of their homeworld.
